summary: Elevra Lithium filed a Form 6-K attaching an ASX announcement disclosing a binding Spodumene Concentrate Supply Agreement with LG Energy Solution for 240,000 dry metric tonnes over three years from first shipment, expected in calendar 2026, plus up to 90,000 dmt optional volume. Pricing is market-linked, adjusted for lithium content. Volumes step from 30,000 dmt in 2026 to 60,000 dmt in 2027-2028 and 90,000 dmt in 2029. This is an ordinary commercial offtake contract, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle is lithium price exposure and LG offtake execution.
